title: Morty's Invisible Belt Gets Him Caught, Then Jerry Ruins the Surrender

cuts.voiceover_text: Morty thinks an invisible belt makes him untouchable. Then Summer puts on thermal goggles and catches him in the act. He tries to act innocent, but the goggles have already ruined the trick. Summer takes the belt, and Morty protests like a kid caught red-handed. They trade the items instead. Morty gets his belt back, but Summer is still the one holding the advantage.

Later, the New Galactic Federation arrives in force. Armed soldiers surround the family while the wrecked ship smolders behind them. Jerry panics and drops the gun. Somehow, that is not the worst part. The invaders demand their target, but Rick steps forward and sells them a different story. He claims Morty has psychic powers and warns them they are making a very bad mistake. The soldiers hesitate. Their confidence starts to crack. The weapon resists, and the bluff somehow gets stronger. Rick orders everybody to drop their guns. The Federation obeys. Jerry is the only one who fumbles the moment, because of course he is. The family stares at Morty in disbelief. For once, the ridiculous plan actually works.
